about: The accounts a new installation starts with (seeded when the database has no account yet, and by npm run seed). Copy this file to config/seed.local.json (gitignored) and put your own accounts there; without that file these generic ones are used. The tests always use this file.
rule: Every password here is a first password only. An admin account is held at the change-password form until it is changed (forced for admins). A learner is never held: the admin sets each learner's own password in Admin → Users before the learner gets the device, so kid1/kid1 and kid2/kid2 never stay in use. Never commit real passwords or real names: keep them in config/seed.local.json.
